name: Buyer Protection Instruction Report V 01
definition: Scope|The BuyerProtectionInstructionReport message is sent by an account servicer to an account owner or its designated agent to report the status of all Buyer Protection Instructions in response to a Buyer Protection Instruction Report Request.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent (the sub-function of the message is Duplicate),|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy),|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information (the sub-function of the message is Copy Duplicate), using the relevant elements in the business application header (BAH).

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part notification is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part notification.

StatementGeneralDetails.name: Statement General Details
StatementGeneralDetails.definition: Provides general information to the report.

FinancialInstitutionIdentification.name: Financial Institution Identification
FinancialInstitutionIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a financial institution, as assigned under an internationally recognised or proprietary identification scheme.

CorporateActionDetails.name: Corporate Action Details
CorporateActionDetails.definition: Information about the related Corporate Action event required for Buyer Protection.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
